findings.detail: R14D=1 is copied to R8D before Freeze regardless of enable argument. Upstream EnableHook also passes ACTION_ENABLE for single-target disable. Do not replace with a guessed ACTION_DISABLE fix.
Enumeration failure returns9. OpenThread/SuspendThread failure marks ID0 and continues with overall success; Get/SetThreadContext failures do not change MH_STATUS.
Origin plus/minus0x40000000 BYTES, clamped to system bounds; max-=0xfff. Pseudocode pointer arithmetic plus/minus0x8000000 on 8-byte elements describes the same1GiB range.
529-byte target decoder table equals the parsed pinned upstream hde64_table byte-for-byte. Static read with full target SHA256 verified first.

No concrete behavior-changing divergence found in selected hook/buffer/trampoline/decoder paths. This is not exhaustive opcode equivalence, compiler equivalence, actual hook testing, or proof of MinHook version.

RemoveHook, QueueEnableHook, QueueDisableHook, ApplyQueued, StatusToString and four-argument CreateHookApi bodies not identified in this bounded retained block. Shipping upstream definitions adds functionality, not evidence of recovered original bodies.

Retained void prototypes on status-returning tail wrappers/AllocateBuffer and byte return on hde64_disasm are decompiler type artifacts. Assembly tail-jumps preserve status return; AllocateBuffer returns slot in RAX; decoder ABI/source return unsigned int.

limitations: Original exact MinHook release/commit and build settings not established.
Selected upstream source is a compatibility dependency, not original source recovered from this DLL.
No machine-code equivalence, exhaustive instruction corpus comparison or native hook execution.
Windows x64 behavior only; upstream x86 APIs and other unused API bodies outside comparison.
